words.prose: {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}) puts the garden interior first, so the couches are discovered inside an already opened domain rather than introduced as detached objects. The suffix keeps the scene tied to the same high garden already named (88:10), and the repeated locative formula from the spring scene (88:12) turns the passage into an accumulating inventory: provision is followed by elevated rest. Even the location-first order matters; the pause-capable boundary lets the container stand first, and the long opening sound releases into the compact plural rhythm of the furnishing.

words.prose: {{ar:سُرُرٌۭ}} ({{tr:sururun}}) is not the object of the preposition; it is the delayed subject disclosed after {{ar:فِيهَا}} ({{tr:fīhā}}), so the garden interior yields a newly encountered class of furnishings. The plural gives abundance without making each couch the focus, and {{ar:مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:marfūʿatun}}) immediately frames that furniture as dignified seating, not mere comfort; the tanwīn-to-mīm join also makes the noun flow audibly into its raised qualifier. The root field is broader than furniture, with joy and inwardness nearby, but the local form selects couches or honor-seats; that means the joy pressure is materialized as prepared repose rather than stated as an abstract emotion. The word also turns the inventory from flowing provision into usable hospitality, opening a sequence of arranged objects that continues with vessels set in place (88:14). Other couch scenes sharpen the local emphasis: 15:47 stresses facing one another, 56:15 stresses woven luxury, while 88:13 stresses elevated dignity.

words.prose: {{ar:مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ}} ({{tr:marfūʿatun}}) closes the ayah by making elevation the final impression of the furnished scene. As a passive participial adjective, it presents the couches as already raised, with the raiser left outside the clause and the achieved state placed before the reader; the feminine singular agreement gathers the many couches under one shared raised quality. The word does not force a choice between height and honor: the furniture is spatially lifted and dignified by that visible height. The echo with the high garden (88:10) brings elevation down into the furnishings, while the later question about the raised sky (88:18) keeps the same root field alive at a larger scale. Parallels such as raised bedding (56:34) and elevated mention (94:4) clarify the range, but here the local grammar keeps the focus on couches bearing a completed, received elevation. The heavier final descriptor stretches the line into raisedness, and the passive completed arrangement anticipates the cups set in place next (88:14).

topics.reason: The surface is a passive participial adjective, not a finite passive verb, active participle, or intransitive rising form, so the local payoff is achieved received elevation.

topics.headline: physical height carries dignity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the couches are not merely tall objects or abstractly honored seats; physical height and rank reinforce each other.
topics.reason: The root range supports both physical lifting and exalted status, and the local furniture context lets visible height carry dignitary force without leaving the concrete couch scene.

topics.reason: The word is the final adjective of the nominal clause, so it completes the local movement from garden interior to furniture to visible raisedness.

topics.headline: elevation field across references

topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows name concrete references, but they serve as range and echo evidence; local grammar keeps the selected sense as the raised state of couches in 88:13.

topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to the actual final adjective and support the same closing elevation payoff without creating a separate lexical sense.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The noun سُرُرٌ and its adjective مَّرْفُوعَةٌ form a compact object-plus-state construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The settled-support branch of س ر ر combines with physical upward displacement in ر ف ع: the objects are couches or throne-like supports whose elevation is materially part of their arrangement.

activation_trace.role: The settled-support image supplies couches as stable places of repose.
Physical upward displacement makes height a concrete property of those supports.

changed_reading.before: There are couches in the scene.
changed_reading.after: There are stable supports deliberately lifted into an upper position, so their height belongs to the scene's spatial design.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same noun-adjective pair can carry affective and social elevation without losing the couch as its material anchor.
baseline_models.mechanism: A couch is a place of settled ease; the joy and prosperity branch of س ر ر colors its use, while the rank branch of ر ف ع turns being raised into dignified station rather than geometry alone.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease give the couch an affective function beyond furnishing.
Settled support keeps the reading anchored in the actual couch noun.
High rank converts elevation into honor and elevated standing.

changed_reading.after: The couches confer honored, ease-filled station: their elevation is social and affective as well as spatial.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّرْفُوعَةٌ modifies the settled supports and can activate presentation or bringing-near within the focus root inventory.
baseline_models.mechanism: The couches remain places of support, but ر ف ع contributes presentation and approach: they read as prepared supports brought into availability for reception.

activation_trace.role: The couch branch supplies the concrete support offered to a recipient.
Bringing near or presenting turns the raised state into prepared availability.

changed_reading.before: The couches simply occupy a high location.
changed_reading.after: The couches are already presented for reception, with elevation carrying readiness and approach as well as height.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The lexical breadth of س ر ر and ر ف ع remains attached to the two overt focus words even when it exceeds their immediate furniture sense.
baseline_models.mechanism: س ر ر holds inward concealment beside joy and ease; ر ف ع can announce or publicize. Their conjunction permits the raised couches to externalize an inward delight that had been hidden.

activation_trace.role: Hidden inwardness supplies the concealed interior pole of the reading.
Joy and ease identify what the concealed interior can contain.
Announcing or making a report public supplies outward manifestation.

changed_reading.before: The verse names visible furniture and nothing more.
changed_reading.after: The visible raised couches can be carried as the public form of an inward, previously concealed ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening brings an arriving, renewed report about something that covers comprehensively. That covering/disclosure tension activates the focus's own concealment and publication branches, making the raised couches a revealed exterior of hidden ease.

activation_trace.role: Inward concealment gives the focus scene something latent that can be disclosed.
Public announcement gives raising a revelatory direction.
Arrival makes disclosure an event that reaches the hearer.
Renewed speech or report supplies the communicative vehicle of manifestation.
Bringing something out and showing it sharpens the report into disclosure.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies the counterforce to disclosure.

structural_cues: The surah opens with an interrogative arrival of a report before the focus scene is shown.
Covering and manifestation coexist in the opening cue, creating a concealment-to-revelation reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies arrival, renewed speech, showing, covering, inward concealment, and public announcement; I infer that the arriving report raises hidden ease into manifestation. The live alternative is that the opening only frames the later furniture and does not alter its semantics.

changed_reading.before: Inward joy made public is only a focus-internal lexical possibility.
changed_reading.after: The arriving report of an enveloping event makes the raised couches a disclosed form of ease that had remained inward and covered.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired faces move from lowered posture, intentional labor, and exhausting strain to softness, earned outcome, and satisfaction. The elevated couch therefore becomes the bodily and social counter-form to being worked down: support that restores bearing and standing.

activation_trace.role: Settled support provides the bodily endpoint opposed to exhausting strain.
High rank turns restored posture into restored standing and honor.
The face as exposed front makes the earlier condition bodily visible.
Lowering and submission establish the downward posture that elevation reverses.
Intentional work supplies the sustained exertion behind the depleted posture.
Weariness and affliction make the labor physically consuming.
Prestige and social face supply the restored outward standing.
Softness and ease supply the felt quality of repose.
Work and earning connect the later condition to completed effort.
Satisfaction marks the reversal as accepted fulfillment rather than mere cessation.

structural_cues: The repeated construction وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ at 88:2 and 88:8 sets the two bodily states in parallel.
The sequence moves from labor plus exhaustion to striving plus satisfaction before describing the furnishings.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lowered posture, labor, exhaustion, renewed prestige, softness, effort, and satisfaction; I infer that the couch mediates a bodily-social reversal from worked-down to supported and honored. The live alternative is that the furniture merely follows the reversal as an unrelated reward item.

changed_reading.before: Raised couches signify static rank and comfort.
changed_reading.after: They enact a reversal: bodies and faces worn downward by labor are given support through which bearing, ease, and honored standing return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier scene routes drink and food through heat, failed sufficiency, and an empty belly. Against that failed reception, the focus's support, joy, and ease become embodied restoration rather than decorative luxury.

activation_trace.role: Joy and ease supply the positive condition produced by restorative reception.
The couch supplies bodily support after the earlier consumptive sequence.
Kindled fire supplies the destructive environment against which repose is measured.
Heating and high temperature intensify the bodily deprivation.
Giving drink invokes quenching, which the hot source reverses into harm.
A flowing water source supplies the origin point of the harmful drink.
Provision and good condition identify what the restricted food fails to deliver.
Sufficiency is explicitly denied, defining deprivation as failed function.
The empty belly supplies the unresolved bodily need.

structural_cues: The passive drinking construction at 88:5 makes the body a recipient before the focus offers a different kind of reception.
The restrictions and paired negations at 88:6-7 define food by its failure to nourish or suffice.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burning heat, offered drink, a source, denied provision, denied sufficiency, hunger, support, and ease; I infer a counter-system in which the couches receive and restore the body. The live alternative is simple contrast between punishments and rewards without a functional reception mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The couches are pleasant objects in a favorable scene.
changed_reading.after: They are stations of bodily restoration, reversing an earlier system that takes in drink and food yet leaves the recipient heated, unsupported, and hungry.

context_deltas.mechanism: A garden screened by vegetation, placed high, and defined by the non-hearing of mixed futile noise activates the inward/private branch of س ر ر. The couches become elevated refuges with visual and acoustic boundaries, not merely conspicuous seats.

activation_trace.role: Inward privacy makes repose secluded rather than publicly displayed.
Settled support keeps the private reading materially attached to the couches.
Physical height separates the resting places from the surrounding plane.
A garden hidden by trees supplies a vegetative screen around the resting place.
Height reinforces spatial separation and protected outlook.
Auditory perception supplies the sensory boundary that the negation closes.
Mixed noisy sound identifies what is excluded from the enclosure.

structural_cues: The locative phrase فِى جَنَّةٍ contains the focus furnishings within a bounded environment.
The explicit auditory negation at 88:11 defines the environment by an absence rather than another object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a tree-screened garden, height, hearing, excluded noise, private inwardness, and support; I infer a visually and acoustically sheltered refuge. The live alternative is that the text promises only the absence of bad speech, without implying enclosure.

changed_reading.before: Raised couches are conspicuous furniture of high status.
changed_reading.after: They are secluded elevated resting places inside a vegetation-screened and noise-excluding refuge, allowing privacy and honor to coexist.

context_deltas.mechanism: Flowing water, handleless cups placed down, cushions aligned, and carpets dispersed organize motion, reach, and surface around the raised supports. The focus is one vertical component in a designed field of access: flow comes through, vessels are ready below, supports rise, rows gather, and floor coverings spread.

activation_trace.role: Settled support supplies the central resting stations in the arrangement.
Upward placement gives the service field its raised vertical layer.
The water source supplies an origin point within the furnished environment.
Continuous movement and flow introduce a path through the otherwise placed objects.
Handleless cups supply immediately usable vessels beside the supports.
Putting something in a lower or fixed place contrasts with and serves the raised layer.
Alignment on an even line supplies ordered lateral repetition.
Dispersal supplies broad coverage across the floor plane.

structural_cues: The locative فِيهَا repeats at 88:12 and 88:13, placing spring and couches in the same spatial field.
The sequence of matched feminine descriptors moves through flowing, raised, placed, aligned, and dispersed states.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies source, flow, usable vessels, downward placement, upward placement, alignment, and dispersal; I infer a designed access gradient rather than a random inventory. The live alternative is a paratactic list whose objects need not form one service system.

changed_reading.before: The couches are one luxurious item among several.
changed_reading.after: They are the elevated resting layer of an engineered hospitality topology that coordinates water flow, reachable vessels, ordered cushions, and floor-wide coverings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later inspection sequence supplies measured creation, borne weight, an overhead sky raised by the same root, solid masses erected, and a lower plane spread out. The raised couch becomes a human-scale repetition of that load-bearing architecture: support lifted over a usable plane within a constructed world.

activation_trace.role: Settled support supplies the human-scale load-bearing object.
Physical elevation forms the exact bridge from couch to raised sky.
Directed sight or insight turns the later objects into inspected mechanisms.
Weight and burden introduce the load that a support system must carry.
Measuring and proportioning supply intentional construction rather than accidental shape.
The sky as what is overhead supplies the largest upper surface in the analogy.
The repeated physical-raising branch explicitly scales the focus elevation up to the sky.
A high solid mass supplies a durable upright member.
Setting something erect and prominent supplies the act of establishing supports.
The lower counterpart to the sky supplies the base plane.
An even extended surface makes the base plane usable and continuous.

structural_cues: The root ر ف ع recurs exactly in the focus adjective at 88:13[3] and the sky predicate at 88:18[4].
The branchless root ك ي ف repeats at 88:17[5], 88:18[3], 88:19[3], and 88:20[3], directing attention to manner and construction without supplying a branch citation.
The inspected sequence runs from burden-bearing creature to overhead sky, upright mountains, and extended ground.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inspection, burden, proportioned making, overhead sky, repeated raising, erected solid masses, and an extended lower plane; I infer that the couch is a human-scale instance of the same support-and-surface grammar. The live alternative is that the repeated root is rhetorical echo and the furniture is not meant as miniature architecture.

changed_reading.before: The couches belong only to an interior furnishing list.
changed_reading.after: Their elevation repeats the construction logic of the inspected world: a proportioned support lifted over a plane, a small architecture nested beneath the raised sky.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus branch of presenting something to authority initially permits throne-like control, but the later command limits the human role to reminder and explicitly denies controlling oversight. The raised support can therefore read as a presented invitation or outcome rather than an instrument of compulsion.

activation_trace.role: The throne-like support supplies the seat whose authority must be qualified.
Presentation or bringing near allows the seat to function as an offered destination.
Reminder and what causes recollection define the permitted communicative action.
State-negation removes coercive oversight from the addressee's role.
The controlling overseer image names the power that the negation excludes.

structural_cues: The restrictive construction at 88:21 narrows the addressee's task to reminding.
The direct negation at 88:22 blocks a coercive reading of that human task.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a reminder, denied controlling oversight, a throne-like support, and presentation; I infer that the couch is offered rather than humanly enforced. The live alternative is that 88:21-22 concerns only the messenger's office and does not color the earlier furniture.

changed_reading.before: A raised throne-like couch can imply domination by whoever occupies or controls it.
changed_reading.after: The support is presented as a destination of reception without making the human reminder an act of coercive enthronement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Turning away and covering truth lead to punishment, return, and accounting. Those cues activate the authority-facing scope of ر ف ع: the raised couch can carry a tribunal or audience-seat valence, so hospitable reception and presentation for account remain contrasting possibilities in the same elevated furniture.

activation_trace.role: The throne-like seat supplies a material locus for audience or adjudication.
Presenting a person or case to authority supplies the tribunal-facing function.
Turning away initiates the path opposite willing reception.
Concealing truth gives the later account a matter to expose and assess.
Punitive pain supplies the consequence attached to the adverse presentation.
Return to a destination supplies movement toward the final audience.
Counting and account supply the adjudicative operation at that destination.

structural_cues: The final sequence is directional: turning away is followed by punishment, return, and then account.
The first-person plural possessive constructions at 88:25-26 place return and account with the same authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies turning away, concealed truth, punishment, return, account, a throne-like support, and presentation to authority; I infer backward tribunal coloring on the raised couch. The live alternative is that the final judicial sequence is wholly separate from the earlier scene of repose.

changed_reading.before: The raised couch is only a seat of hospitable reception.
changed_reading.after: It also bears a contained tribunal valence: elevated reception can contrast with being returned and presented for account before authority.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus adjective ordinarily describes height, while its cited branch is a cord for lifting a prisoner's shackle and the striving branch concerns earning release from bondage. It remains anchored in the focus's support and raising roots and is reinforced by 88:9, but downstream prose should render it only as a legal-material resonance of release, not as the lexical translation of مَّرْفُوعَةٌ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The couch is a place of settled support, while the focus root ر ف ع itself contains the image of lifting a restraint.

activation_trace.role: Settled repose supplies the condition reached after release.
The shackle-lifting cord turns elevation into the material easing of constraint.
A bound person's earning toward freedom supplies the effort-to-release path.
Satisfaction supplies the accepted outcome of the release path.

changed_reading.before: Raised couches indicate height after completed striving.
changed_reading.after: They can also resonate as supports reached when striving has lifted constraint, turning elevation into release from what bound the body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the source occurrence at 88:26 is account, not upholstery, while its B008 branch names a cushion. It remains valid as a branch-backed material echo that returns directly to the focus couch, but downstream prose must not translate حِسَاب as cushion or claim that comfort cancels reckoning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus names a raised couch, so a later root branch that independently returns to cushioning touches its material core.

activation_trace.role: The couch branch supplies the resting furniture to which the later echo returns.
Physical elevation keeps the echoed cushion attached to the focus construction.
Counting and account supply the overt final operation.
The cushion branch unexpectedly loops the account root back into the material vocabulary of repose.

changed_reading.before: The final account is semantically separate from the raised couches.
changed_reading.after: The account root's cushion branch folds reckoning back into the couch's material field, allowing repose and accountability to remain uncomfortably co-present.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant ء و ن mapping of 88:5's ء ن ي cue and its branch for an iwan or vaulted building. It remains spatially anchored by the raised couch and the high garden, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant architectural activation, not as the meaning of ءَانِيَةٍ in context.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A settled support physically raised can occupy and help articulate an elevated architectural chamber.

activation_trace.role: The couch supplies the furnishing housed by the activated chamber.
Physical elevation lets the furnishing participate in the chamber's vertical structure.
The split-mapped iwan or vaulted-building image supplies an architectural envelope.
Height makes that possible envelope consistent with the focus's elevated placement.

changed_reading.before: The couches are raised as isolated furniture in an open scene.
changed_reading.after: They can be imagined as the furnished level of a high vaulted reception chamber, with elevation shared by object and architectural envelope.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited س ر ر branch concerns lines or folds of palm and forehead rather than the surface noun's ordinary couch sense. It remains anchored through the same focus root, the repeated faces, joy, and public manifestation, but downstream prose should call it a visual analogy: the furniture spatializes an eased face rather than literally meaning facial lines.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural couch form activates a same-root branch of forehead lines beside joy and ease, while its adjective can publicize what was inward.

activation_trace.role: Lines and folds of the forehead supply the visual pattern that can be spatialized.
Joy and ease give the facial pattern its changed affect.
Public manifestation lets inward ease become visible in face and furnishing.
The earlier face supplies the first surface on which condition is displayed.
The repeated face supplies the transformed counterpart.
Softness and ease specify the new expression carried by the later face.

changed_reading.before: The changed faces and the raised couches are separate visual details.
changed_reading.after: The couches can act as a spatialized expression of the eased face: lines of inward joy raised into a visible arrangement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the س ر ر branch of tender plant tips inside a noun ordinarily read as couches. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and gains ecological support from enclosing growth and running water, but downstream prose should retain it as a biomorphic material analogy, not claim that the couches are literally plants.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's س ر ر inventory includes moist upper plant growth, and مَّرْفُوعَةٌ supplies its upward orientation.

activation_trace.role: Tender moist plant tips supply a living material image for the couch form.
Physical raising orients that tender growth upward.
Entwined and surging vegetation supplies a larger living matrix around the focus.
The water source supplies moisture for the activated plant image.
Running flow makes that moisture continuous through the environment.

changed_reading.before: The raised couches are inert manufactured objects.
changed_reading.after: They acquire a contained biomorphic quality: tender upper growth lifted within an enclosing garden and continually fed by running water.

strongest_changes: Physical height became a designed service topology when flow, low placement, alignment, and dispersal organized the surrounding furnishings.
Static honor became a bodily-social reversal from lowered exhaustion to supported ease and restored standing.
The exact recurrence of ر ف ع with the sky scaled the couch into a human-sized instance of the world's support-and-surface architecture.
Concealment, arriving report, and publication let visible couches carry the disclosure of inward ease.
Presentation remained double: non-coercive invitation and tribunal-facing account coexist without being merged.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots were unusually polyphonic. س ر ر held settled support, inward secrecy, joy, facial lines, and tender growth, while ر ف ع held physical elevation, rank, presentation, publication, and the lifting of constraint. Context converted those branches into bodily reversal, acoustic refuge, service geometry, miniature cosmological architecture, release, and reckoning rather than forcing one final furniture gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: Physical elevation remains the strongest local reading, but the relative weight of rank, presentation, and publication cannot be resolved from the focus construction alone.
Some same-root branches may function only as resonant images rather than active senses of the surface noun or adjective.
The creation sequence may deliberately recolor the couch through repeated ر ف ع, or it may begin a separate rhetorical movement.
The non-dominant ء ن ي to ء و ن architectural activation is worth preserving only with explicit form-distance containment.
The tribunal and account readings are structurally available but should not displace the equally live hospitality and refuge readings.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seats as settled support raised in rank.** Evidence: `س ر ر` B011 place of settled support/bed/couch; `ر ف ع` B001 raising upward, B002 high rank. Structural cue: the garden furnishings begin with elevated couches. Role: support and elevation combine as restful honor. Abductive move: the body formerly lowered or exhausted is now given a raised support. Reading change: the ayah reads as reversal of `خاشعة`/`ناصبة`: no longer lowered by toil, the body is upheld.

2. **Inner joy made into furniture.** Evidence: `س ر ر` B010 joy/ease, B001 hidden inward matter; `ر ض و` B001 satisfaction in 88:9. Structural cue: satisfaction precedes couches; garden objects follow. Role: the couch materializes inner joy as a place to rest. Abductive move: eschatological furnishings externalize states of the self. Reading change: `سرر` carries joy and secrecy as well as literal seats.

3. **Raised report/publicity without vain speech.** Evidence: `ر ف ع` B005 announcing/spreading a report; `س م ع` B005 reputation/public circulation; `ل غ و` B002 vain speech excluded. Structural cue: sound is purified before objects are raised. Role: elevation includes lawful publicity, not noisy vanity. Abductive move: a place without false talk can still have honorable mention. Reading change: `مرفوعة` also signals exalted recognition.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The earlier lowered faces and later raised sky formed a vertical arc around the couches. The auditory purification in 88:11 made `ر ف ع` B005 safer to preserve: raised mention is possible only after vain speech is excluded.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Raised couches convert inward joy into bodily supported rest.** **Lexical:** `س ر ر` B011, "place of settled support," and B010, "joy and ease"; `ر ف ع` B001, physical raising. **Cue:** the couches follow soft faces, satisfaction, a high garden, quiet, and flowing water in 88:8-12. **Role:** the support branch gives the body a stable resting place, the joy branch names its affective correlate, and elevation distinguishes this rest from collapse or depletion. **Abduction:** I infer that supported posture helps produce or express the preceding ease. **Reading change:** `سرر` are not decorative furniture; they are the bodily mechanism by which the habitat's inward ease becomes a settled posture.

2. **The local furnishing is a human-scale analogue of the raised sky.** **Lexical:** `ر ف ع` B001, raising something upward, and B002, high rank. **Cue:** the exact root recurs in passive form at 88:18, `ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ`, while 88:10 has already called the garden high. **Role:** the couch gives elevation a usable domestic scale; the sky gives it a cosmic scale; B002 lets both carry honor as well as geometry. **Abduction:** I infer that root repetition asks the reader to compare the two levels of construction. **Reading change:** raised seating becomes a local participation in a larger vertical order, not an isolated luxury.

3. **Elevation presents the resting place rather than withdrawing it.** **Lexical:** `ر ف ع` B004, "bringing near or presenting," alongside B001. **Cue:** the raised couches are immediately followed by placed cups, rowed cushions, and spread carpets in 88:14-16. **Role:** B004 turns raising into presentation within a service arrangement; surrounding placement keeps elevated honor accessible. **Abduction:** I infer that the furnishings are staged for occupants rather than merely stored. **Reading change:** `مرفوعة` can signal readiness and presentation: the couches are raised into available prominence.

4. **Concealment becomes privacy rather than deprivation.** **Lexical:** `س ر ر` B001, keeping something hidden inwardly, activated beside B011 support. **Cue:** the couches occur inside the covered garden after the exclusion of vain sound in 88:11. **Role:** the secret/inward branch gives settled support a protected interior quality. **Abduction:** I infer privacy from enclosure plus acoustic peace; no partition is named. **Reading change:** the resting places can be read as secure inward spaces where repose is protected from public intrusion.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 88:14-16 first clarified `ر ف ع` B004 as presentation: the raised place remains usable because other objects are placed, aligned, and spread around it. 88:18 then supplied the decisive surprise by repeating `ر ف ع` for the sky, turning a couch into a domestic-scale analogue of cosmic elevation.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi, özellikle gizli kalmış bir haberi açığa çıkarıp yaymayı ve bunu aktaran bir topluluğu açıkça aynı duyurma alanında toplar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Çıplak biçim açığa çıkarıp yaymayı anlatır; belirli kişi ve yönetici ilişkisine bağlı kalıp ile haber taşıyan topluluk adı ayrı gerçekleşmeler olarak korunur.

facets.statement: Bir haberi açığa çıkarıp insanlar arasında yaymak.
Aktardığı haberi başkalarına ulaştırıp yayan topluluk.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar haberin gizlilikten çıkarılıp yayılmasında birleşir; haberi duyuran topluluk, temel yayma eyleminin katılımcısı olarak ayrıca belirtilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir haberin gizli veya dar çevrede kalmaktan çıkıp başkalarına duyurulduğu bağlamlarda uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Haberin bir topluluk aracılığıyla birçok kişiye ulaştırıldığı akıcı metin bağlamlarında uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Daha önce gizli olan içeriği açığa çıkarma ayrıntısını açıkça söylemez.

error_profile.preserves: Bir içeriği başkasının bilgisine ulaştırmayı korur.
error_profile.adds: Tek kişiye özel ve yayılmayan her türlü bilgilendirmeyi de kapsar.
error_profile.collision: Açığa çıkarma ve yayma koşulları görünmez hale gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dişi devenin sütünü veya doğumdan sonraki ilk sütünü memesinde tutup vermemesini açıkça tanımlar; geçici doluluk tek başına yeterli değildir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Hayvanın sütü vermemesi davranışını belirtir.
